source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 21 exercise solved (PDF 183-186): MCQ keys, model answers and step-by-step numericals; printed answers checked (21.6 unit corrected).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Space and Environment) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer. (Sahi jawab chunein.)

blocks.prompt:
21.1 What does the term “luminosity” refer to in the context of stars?
(Sitaron ke silsile mein "luminosity" se kya muraad hai?)

options.text: The brightness of a star as seen from Earth
The total energy a star absorbs
The total power of radiation emitted by a star
The colour of a star's surface

blocks.explanation: Luminosity sitare ki taraf se har second kharij hone wali kul energy (electromagnetic radiation) hai, yani us ki kul power, jo watt mein napi jati hai (L = 4πr²σT⁴). Zameen se nazar aane wali chamak radiant flux intensity hai, luminosity nahi.

blocks.prompt:
21.2 Why are standard candles important in astronomy?
(Astronomy mein standard candles kyun aham hain?)

options.text: These reflect light from nearby stars
These are used to measure star temperatures
Their known luminosity helps to measure distances to galaxies
These are sources of blackbody radiation

blocks.explanation: Standard candle (jaise Cepheid variable ya Type Ia supernova) ki luminosity pehle se maloom hoti hai. Zameen par us ka flux F naap kar inverse-square law se fasla (distance) nikal aata hai: d = √(L/4πF).

blocks.prompt:
21.3 According to Wien's displacement law, when the surface temperature of a star increases, its peak wavelength of emitted radiation:
(Wien ke displacement law ke mutabiq jab sitare ka surface temperature barhta hai to us ki peak wavelength kya hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: λmax T = b (constant), is liye λmax ∝ 1/T (ulta tanasub). Zyada garam sitare ki peak chhoti wavelength par hoti hai (garam sitare neele-safaid, thande sitare laal nazar aate hain).

blocks.prompt:
21.4 Which equation correctly represents the Stefan-Boltzmann law?
(Kaun si equation Stefan-Boltzmann law ko sahi dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Luminosity = satah ka area × har unit area se nikalne wali power: L = (4πr²)(σT⁴) = 4πr²σT⁴ (Eq. 21.1), jahan σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴.

blocks.prompt:
21.5 To estimate a star's radius, which combination of laws is most useful?
(Sitare ka radius (nisf qutr) andaza karne ke liye kaun se qawaneen ka milap sab se mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radius Stefan-Boltzmann law se nikalta hai: r = √(L/4πσT⁴); is se pehle T Wien's law se nikala jata hai (Section 21.5). Chhape options mein sirf (b) mein woh law hai jo r deta hai; (a) aur (d) ke qawaneen sitare ke size ke bare mein kuch nahi batate, aur akela Wien's law (c) sirf temperature deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal qawaneen ka milap (combination) poochhta hai, magar kisi option mein woh milap nahi jo chapter (Section 21.5) istemal karta hai: pehle Wien's law se T, phir Stefan-Boltzmann law (luminosity ke saath) se r, yani (b) aur (c) dono mil kar. Sab se qareeb jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.6 What does a redshift in the spectral lines of a distant galaxy indicate?
(Door ki galaxy ki spectral lines mein redshift kya batata hai?)

options.text: The galaxy is moving towards us
The wavelength of emitted light is increasing

blocks.explanation: Redshift ka matlab hai ke lines lab wali qeemat se lambi wavelength par nazar aati hain (Δλ musbat): universe ke phailne se galaxy door ja rahi hai aur roshni khinch (stretch) jati hai. Chhoti wavelength ki taraf shift (blueshift) ka matlab hota ke galaxy qareeb aa rahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.7 Hubble's law states that the velocity of a galaxy is proportional to its:
(Hubble ka law kehta hai ke galaxy ki velocity kis cheez ke mutanasib (proportional) hai?)
blocks.explanation: v ∝ d, yani v = H₀d (Eq. 21.5), jahan H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹: galaxy jitni door, utni tezi se door ja rahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.8 Which of the following is not one of the five interacting components of Earth's climate system?
(In mein se kaun sa Zameen ke climate system ke paanch hisson mein shamil nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Paanch hisse yeh hain: atmosphere (hawa), hydrosphere (paani), cryosphere (barf), lithosphere (pathreeli upri teh) aur biosphere (jandar). Troposphere to atmosphere ki sab se nichli teh hai, alag hissa nahi.

blocks.prompt:
21.9 Why does air deflect to the right in the northern hemisphere?
(Shimali nisf kurrah (northern hemisphere) mein hawa daein taraf kyun murti hai?)

options.text: Due to conservation of angular momentum

blocks.explanation: Chalti hawa Zameen ke axis ke gird apna specific angular momentum L = rv qaim rakhti hai (Section 21.12). Doosre latitude par jane se r badalta hai aur us ki mashriq (east) ki taraf speed neeche ghoomti zameen se nahi milti, is liye hawa mur jati hai (Coriolis effect): northern hemisphere mein daein aur southern mein baein.

blocks.prompt:
21.10 The thermohaline circulation is primarily driven by
(Thermohaline circulation zyada tar kis wajah se chalti hai?)

options.text: differences in temperature and salinity of ocean water

blocks.explanation: ‘Thermo’ = temperature aur ‘haline’ = namak. Thanda aur namkeen paani zyada dense (ghana) hota hai aur poles ke qareeb neeche baith jata hai; yehi density ka farq gehre samandar ki aahista "global conveyor belt" chalata hai. Satah ke currents zyada tar hawa se chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
21.1 Define luminosity in the context of a star.
Sitare ke silsile mein luminosity ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Luminosity sitare ki taraf se har second electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein kharij hone wali kul energy hai, yani sitare ki kul power. Is ka unit watt hai aur yeh sitare ke radius aur surface temperature par munhasir hai: L = 4πr²σT⁴.

blocks.prompt:
21.2 State the inverse-square law for radiant flux intensity and explain its significance.
Radiant flux intensity ka inverse-square law bayan karein aur us ki ahmiyat batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Sitare ki radiant flux intensity F us ke fasle d ke square ke ulta mutanasib (inversely proportional) hai: F = L/4πd². Fasla dugna ho to flux chautha (1/4), teen guna ho to 1/9 reh jata hai.
Ahmiyat: is se napa gaya flux, luminosity aur fasla aapas mein jur jate hain; do maloom hon to teesra nikal aata hai (misal: standard candles se fasla, sitaron ki luminosity).

blocks.prompt:
21.3 What is a standard candle, and how is it used to measure distances to galaxies?
Standard candle kya hai aur galaxies ka fasla napne mein kaise kaam aati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Standard candle aisi astronomical cheez hai jis ki luminosity (asal chamak) maloom ho, jaise Cepheid variable sitara ya Type Ia supernova.
Zameen par us ka flux F napa jata hai, phir maloom luminosity L se inverse-square law ke zariye fasla nikalta hai: d = √(L/4πF).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho raat ko door ek 100 watt ka bulb jal raha hai. Aap ko pata hai ke bulb 100 watt ka hai (luminosity maloom). Agar woh bohat dheema lag raha hai to woh bohat door hai. Standard candle aasman ka yehi "maloom watt wala bulb" hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.4 State Stefan-Boltzmann’s law and mention the physical quantities it relates.
Stefan-Boltzmann law bayan karein aur batayein ke yeh kin physical quantities ko jorta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Sitare ki kul power us ki satah ke area aur temperature ki chauthi power (T⁴) ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib hai: L = 4πr²σT⁴.
Yeh luminosity L (W), radius r (m) aur surface temperature T (K) ko jorta hai; σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ Stefan-Boltzmann constant hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.5 How can you estimate the radius of a star using Wien's and Stefan-Boltzmann laws?
Wien aur Stefan-Boltzmann ke qawaneen se sitare ka radius kaise andaza kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Sitare ke spectrum se peak wavelength λmax naapein; Wien's law se T = b/λmax.
2. Napa gaya flux aur fasla istemal kar ke luminosity nikalein: L = 4πd²F.
3. Phir Stefan-Boltzmann law L = 4πr²σT⁴ se r = √(L/4πσT⁴).

blocks.prompt:
21.6 State Hubble's law, what is its connection to the Big Bang Theory?
Hubble ka law bayan karein; Big Bang Theory se is ka kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Hubble ka law: galaxy ki door jane ki velocity (recession velocity) Zameen se us ke fasle ke seedha mutanasib hai, v = H₀d (H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹).
Talluq: tamam door ki galaxies ek doosre se door ja rahi hain, yani universe phail raha hai. Waqt ko ulta chalayein to tamam maadda kabhi bohat chhoti, ghani aur garam haalat mein tha; yehi Big Bang Theory hai (universe taqreeban 13.8 arab saal pehle shuru hua).

blocks.prompt:
21.7 List the five major components of Earth's climate system.
Zameen ke climate system ke paanch bare hisse likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Atmosphere (hawa)
2. Hydrosphere (paani)
3. Cryosphere (barf aur jami hui zameen, permafrost)
4. Lithosphere (Zameen ki upri pathreeli teh)
5. Biosphere (jandar)

blocks.prompt:
21.1 Why do astronomers use radiant flux intensity instead of total power to compare stars at different distances?
Mukhtalif faslon par sitaron ka muqabla karne ke liye astronomers kul power ki bajaye radiant flux intensity kyun istemal karte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Sitare ki kul power (luminosity) seedhi nahi napi ja sakti: Zameen par telescope us ka bohat chhota hissa hi pakarta hai. Asal mein jo napa jata hai woh radiant flux intensity F hai, yani har second har unit area par Zameen tak pohanchne wali energy.
F luminosity aur fasle dono par munhasir hai: F = L/4πd². Is liye dheema sitara door ka taqatwar sitara bhi ho sakta hai aur qareeb ka kamzor sitara bhi. F naap kar inverse-square law se, d maloom ho to L, aur L maloom ho to d (standard candles) nikal aata hai; is tarah mukhtalif faslon wale sitaron ka sahi muqabla hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.2 What is the role of standard candles in determining distances to far away galaxies? Explain why their known luminosity is critical for accurate measurements.
Door ki galaxies ka fasla maloom karne mein standard candles ka kya kirdar hai? Wazahat karein ke un ki maloom luminosity durust naap ke liye kyun zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation:
Kirdar: galaxies itni door hain ke seedhe tareeqe kaam nahi karte. Galaxy mein nazar aane wali standard candle (Cepheid variable, Type Ia supernova) ki luminosity L maloom hoti hai. Zameen par us ka flux F naap kar inverse-square law se galaxy ka fasla nikalta hai: d = √(L/4πF). Type Ia supernova intehai roshan hota hai, is liye bohat door ki galaxies ke liye bhi kaam aata hai.
Maloom luminosity kyun zaroori hai: fasla L se nikalta hai, d ∝ √L. Agar L maloom na ho (ya ghalat ho) to wahi flux door ki roshan cheez ka bhi ho sakta hai aur qareeb ki dheemi cheez ka bhi, aur fasla nahi nikal sakta. L ki har ghalti seedhi d mein aa jati hai (misal: L chaar guna zyada maan lein to d dugna ghalat aayega). Is liye sirf woh cheezein standard candle ban sakti hain jin ki luminosity bharosemand aur pehle se maloom ho.

blocks.prompt:
21.3 Why do the lines in the emission or absorption spectra of distant galaxies appear at longer wavelengths than expected, and what does this tell us about their motion?
Door ki galaxies ke emission ya absorption spectra ki lines tawaqqo se lambi wavelengths par kyun nazar aati hain, aur yeh un ki harkat ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Har element lab mein muqarrar wavelengths par lines deta hai. Door ki galaxies ki roshni mein yehi lines laal (red) sire ki taraf, yani lambi wavelength par khiski hui milti hain; yeh redshift hai, Z = Δλ/λ ≈ v/c.
Wajah: universe phail raha hai. Roshni ke safar ke dauran hamare aur galaxy ke darmiyan space khinchti (stretch hoti) hai, is liye light waves bhi khinch kar lambi wavelength wali ho jati hain.
Harkat: musbat Δλ ka matlab hai galaxy hum se door ja rahi hai (blueshift ka matlab qareeb aana). Redshift har simt mein nazar aata hai, yani tamam door ki galaxies door ja rahi hain; jitna zyada redshift, utni tez raftaar aur utna zyada fasla (Hubble's law). Yeh phailte universe aur Big Bang Theory ki daleel hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rubber band par do nuqte (dots) lagao aur us par ek lehar (wave) banao. Rubber band khincho to nuqte door ho jate hain aur lehar bhi lambi ho jati hai. Phailti space mein roshni ki lehar ke saath yehi hota hai, is liye wavelength lambi (red ki taraf) ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.4 How would the spectrum of light from galaxies look different if the universe were not expanding?
Agar universe na phail raha hota to galaxies ki roshni ka spectrum kaisa mukhtalif nazar aata?
blocks.explanation:
Agar universe na phailta to cosmic redshift na hota:
1. Door ki galaxies ki spectral lines apni lab wali wavelengths par (ya un ke bohat qareeb) nazar aatin, jaise Suraj ke spectrum ki lines.
2. Agar koi chhoti shift hoti to sirf galaxies ki apni be-tarteeb harkat se, kuch thori red aur kuch thori blue (chapter se aage), koi aam pattern na hota.
3. Redshift aur fasle mein koi talluq na hota, yani Hubble's law na hota; door ki galaxies qareeb walon se zyada redshift na dikhatin.
Is liye har simt mein fasle ke saath barhta hua redshift hi universe ke phailne ka saboot hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.5 Describe how energy transfer from the Sun influences global climate patterns. How does the imbalance of solar energy between the equator and the poles affect atmospheric circulation?
Suraj se energy ki muntaqili (energy transfer) global climate ke patterns par kaise asar karti hai? Equator aur poles ke darmiyan solar energy ka adam tawazun (imbalance) atmospheric circulation par kaise asar karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Suraj se energy: Suraj ki radiation Zameen ki satah aur hawa ko garam karti hai. Kuch hissa (badal, barf, registan se) wapas reflect ho jata hai aur baqi jazb hota hai; Zameen infrared ki shakal mein energy wapas kharij karti hai. Yeh tawazun (Earth's energy budget) Zameen ka temperature tay karta hai, aur mukhtalif ilaqon ki be-barabar garmi hawaon, samandari currents, bukharat (evaporation) aur barish ko chalati hai jo climate ke patterns banate hain.
Equator aur poles ka farq:
1. Equator par seedhi aur tez dhoop parti hai; poles par tirchhi aur kamzor dhoop zyada area par phailti hai.
2. Equator par garam hawa upar uthti hai aur low pressure banta hai; poles par thandi hawa neeche baithti hai aur high pressure banta hai.
3. Hawa high se low pressure ki taraf chalti hai aur garmi equator se poles ki taraf jati hai.
4. Zameen ki gardish (angular momentum ka tahaffuz, Coriolis effect) ki wajah se chalti hawa murti hai (north mein daein, south mein baein), is liye har hemisphere mein teen cells bante hain: Hadley, Ferrel aur Polar cell.
5. In se hawaon ki pattiyan (wind belts) banti hain: equator ke qareeb trade winds, darmiyani latitudes par westerlies aur poles ke qareeb polar easterlies. Samandari currents ke saath mil kar yeh poori duniya mein garmi baant-ti hain.

blocks.prompt:
21.6 Explain how human activities, such as increasing greenhouse gases, can create an imbalance in Earth's energy budget.
Wazahat karein ke insani sargarmiyan, jaise greenhouse gases ka barhna, Zameen ke energy budget mein adam tawazun kaise paida karti hain.
blocks.explanation:
Zameen ka energy budget us waqt barabar hai jab jazb hone wali solar energy utni hi ho jitni infrared energy wapas space mein jati hai; tab temperature qaim rehta hai.
Insani sargarmiyan (fossil fuels jalana, jungle kaatna) hawa mein carbon dioxide aur methane jaisi greenhouse gases barhati hain. Yeh gases dhoop ko andar aane deti hain magar bahar jane wali infrared radiation ko jazb kar ke rok leti hain aur us ka kuch hissa wapas zameen ki taraf bhejti hain.
Is tarah space mein jane wali energy jazb hone wali energy se kam ho jati hai: aane wali > jane wali. Zaid energy Zameen ko garam karti hai (global warming).
Garmi se barf pighalti hai, gehri (dark) zameen aur samandar khul jate hain jo zyada dhoop jazb aur kam reflect karte hain, aur Zameen mazeed garam hoti hai. Sirf 1% ka adam tawazun bhi duniya ke temperature mein bari tabdeeli la sakta hai, jis se mausam, samandar ki satah aur samandari circulation badal jate hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Greenhouse gases ko kambal (blanket) samjho. Kambal garmi paida nahi karta, sirf jism ki garmi ko bahar jane se rokta hai. Kambal jitna mota, andar utni garmi. Hawa mein greenhouse gases barhne se Zameen ka kambal mota ho raha hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.1 How does the concept of luminosity help astronomers understand the nature of stars, and how is the inverse-square law used to calculate how bright a star appears from Earth? Support your answer with an example.
Luminosity ka tasawwur astronomers ko sitaron ki nature samajhne mein kaise madad deta hai, aur inverse-square law se kaise hisaab lagaya jata hai ke sitara Zameen se kitna roshan nazar aata hai? Misal ke saath jawab dein.
blocks.explanation:
Luminosity: sitare ki taraf se har second electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein kharij hone wali kul energy, yani us ki kul power (unit W). Yeh sitare ki asal (intrinsic) chamak hai, hamare fasle par munhasir nahi.
Sitaron ki nature kaise samajh aati hai:
1. Stefan-Boltzmann law L = 4πr²σT⁴ ke mutabiq luminosity radius aur surface temperature par munhasir hai.
2. Bara sitara (zyada surface area) zyada luminous hai; barabar size ke do sitaron mein garam wala kahin zyada luminous hai (L ∝ T⁴; T dugna to L 16 guna).
3. L aur T maloom hon to radius nikal aata hai; luminosity se bare (giant) aur chhote sitaron mein farq aur barabar ki bunyaad par muqabla hota hai.
Inverse-square law: sitare ki power us ke gird radius d wale kurre (sphere) par barabar phailti hai jis ka area 4πd² hai. Zameen par radiant flux intensity (nazar aane wali chamak):
F = L/4πd²
yani F ∝ 1/d²: fasla 2d par flux 1/4, 3d par 1/9. Sitara is liye bhi dheema lag sakta hai ke woh door hai, na ke kamzor.
Misal (Suraj): L = 3.9 × 10²⁶ W, d = 1.5 × 10¹¹ m
F = L/4πd² = (3.9 × 10²⁶ W)/[4 × 3.14 × (1.5 × 10¹¹ m)²]
F = (3.9 × 10²⁶ W)/(2.83 × 10²³ m²) = 1.38 × 10³ W m⁻²
Dugne fasle par flux 1.38 × 10³/4 ≈ 3.4 × 10² W m⁻² hota. (Kitab ki Example 21.2: L = 4.50 × 10²⁶ W, 1.40 × 10¹¹ m par F = 1.83 × 10³ W m⁻².)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kamre mein ek bulb socho. Bulb ki asal taqat (watt) uski luminosity hai, jo nahi badalti. Aap bulb se jitna door jate ho, roshni utne bare area par phail jati hai, is liye aap ki kitab par kam roshni girti hai. Fasla dugna = roshni chautha hissa.

blocks.prompt:
21.2 Explain how astronomers use standard candles to measure distances to galaxies. What makes a star or object suitable to be used as a standard candle? Provide a relevant example.
Wazahat karein ke astronomers standard candles se galaxies ka fasla kaise naapte hain. Kisi sitare ya cheez ko standard candle banane ke liye kya khoobiyan chahiye? Munasib misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Standard candles: aisi astronomical cheezein jin ki asal chamak (luminosity) maloom ho; in se kainaat ke faslay naape jate hain.
Tareeqa:
1. Galaxy mein standard candle (jaise Cepheid variable ya Type Ia supernova) pehchanein; us ki luminosity L maloom hai.
2. Zameen par us ki radiant flux intensity F (nazar aane wali chamak) naapein.
3. Inverse-square law F = L/4πd² lagayein: d = √(L/4πF).
Nazar aane wali chamak ka asal chamak se muqabla fasla deta hai, aur yehi galaxy ka fasla hai.
Munasib cheez ki khoobiyan:
1. Luminosity maloom aur pehle se andaza-pazeer (predictable) ho (apni qism ki sab cheezon ki ek jaisi, ya kisi naapne wali khoobi se tay ho).
2. Bohat roshan ho, taake door ki galaxies mein bhi nazar aaye.
3. Aasani se pehchani jaye (light curve ya spectrum se).
Misalein: Cepheid variable sitare jo ek muqarrar andaaz se dharakte (pulse karte) hain aur is se un ki luminosity pata chalti hai (Henrietta Leavitt, 1910s); Type Ia supernova jin ki peak luminosity taqreeban ek jaisi aur bohat zyada hoti hai aur bohat door se nazar aate hain.
Hal shuda misal (Numerical 21.2): supernova L = 1.0 × 10³⁶ W, flux F = 2.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻²:
d = √[L/(4πF)] = √[(1.0 × 10³⁶ W)/(4 × 3.14 × 2.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻²)] = √(3.98 × 10⁴⁶ m²) ≈ 2.0 × 10²³ m

blocks.prompt:
21.3 How does Wien's displacement law help determine the temperature of a star from its emitted light? Describe the relationship between the peak wavelength and temperature with suitable examples or calculations.
Wien ka displacement law sitare ki roshni se us ka temperature maloom karne mein kaise madad deta hai? Peak wavelength aur temperature ka talluq misalon ya hisaab se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Sitare blackbody ki tarah hote hain: woh continuous spectrum kharij karte hain jis ki shakal sirf surface temperature par munhasir hai. Intensity aur wavelength ke graph ki ek peak λmax par hoti hai, aur temperature barhne par peak chhoti wavelength ki taraf khisakti hai (Fig. 21.4).
Wien ka displacement law: blackbody ki zyada se zyada intensity wali wavelength us ke surface temperature ke ulta mutanasib hai:
λmax ∝ 1/T, yani λmax T = b, b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K
T kaise nikalein: sitare ka spectrum naapein, λmax maloom karein, phir T = b/λmax.
Talluq: garam sitaron ki peak chhoti wavelength par hoti hai aur woh neele-safaid lagte hain; thande sitaron ki peak lambi wavelength par aur woh laal lagte hain. λmax aadha ho to T dugna.
Misal 1: λmax = 500 nm wala sitara:
T = (2.9 × 10⁻³ m K)/(500 × 10⁻⁹ m) = 5800 K (Suraj jaisa peela sitara)
Misal 2: laal sitara λmax = 1000 nm:
T = (2.9 × 10⁻³ m K)/(1000 × 10⁻⁹ m) = 2900 K
Misal 3 (Example 21.3): sitara 1: T₁ = 6000 K, λmax1 = 480 nm; sitara 2: λmax2 = 320 nm:
T₂ = λmax1T₁/λmax2 = (480 nm × 6000 K)/(320 nm) = 9000 K
Chhoti peak wavelength batati hai ke doosra sitara zyada garam hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lohe ki salakh ko garam karo: pehle dheemi laal, phir naranji, phir peeli-safaid chamakti hai. Temperature barhne se roshni ka "sab se tez rang" chhoti wavelength (laal se neele) ki taraf jata hai. Sitaron ka rang dekh kar bhi isi tarah un ka temperature pata chalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.4 State the Stefan-Boltzmann law. How can this law be applied to calculate a star's luminosity and radius if its temperature and energy output are known? Provide an example.
Stefan-Boltzmann law bayan karein. Agar sitare ka temperature aur energy output maloom ho to is law se us ki luminosity aur radius kaise nikalte hain? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Stefan-Boltzmann law: sitare ki kul power us ki satah ke area aur temperature ki chauthi power ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib hai:
L = 4πr²σT⁴ (σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴)
Yahan 4πr² sitare ki satah ka area aur σT⁴ har unit area se nikalne wali power hai.
Luminosity (r aur T maloom hon): seedha L = 4πr²σT⁴ mein qeematein rakhein.
Misal: radius 7.0 × 10⁸ m aur surface temperature 5800 K wala sitara (taqreeban Suraj):
L = 4 × 3.14 × (7.0 × 10⁸ m)² × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ × (5800 K)⁴
L = 4 × 3.14 × 4.9 × 10¹⁷ m² × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ × 1.13 × 10¹⁵ K⁴ = 3.9 × 10²⁶ W
Radius (energy output L aur T maloom hon): formula ulta karein, r = √(L/4πσT⁴). T Wien's law se (T = b/λmax) aur L energy output se (ya flux se, L = 4πd²F).
Misal (Example 21.1): L = 2.5 × 10²⁶ W, T = 6000 K:
r = √[(2.5 × 10²⁶ W)/(4 × 3.14 × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ × (6000 K)⁴)]
r = √[(2.5 × 10²⁶)/(9.23 × 10⁸)] m = √(2.71 × 10¹⁷) m = 5.2 × 10⁸ m

blocks.prompt:
21.5 What is redshift, and how does the shifting of spectral lines support the idea that the universe is expanding? Explain using the redshift formula and describe how this leads to Hubble's law and the Big Bang Theory.
Redshift kya hai, aur spectral lines ka khisakna universe ke phailne ke tasawwur ki kaise taeed karta hai? Redshift formula se wazahat karein aur batayein ke yeh Hubble's law aur Big Bang Theory tak kaise le jata hai.
blocks.explanation:
Redshift: door ki galaxy ki roshni ki wavelength ka lab wali qeemat se barh jana, yani spectral lines ka spectrum ke laal (red) sire ki taraf khisakna.
Redshift formula:
Z = Δλ/λ ≈ Δf/f ≈ v/c
jahan Δλ = λnazar aane wali − λlab, λ lab wali wavelength, v galaxy ki hamari seedh mein speed aur c roshni ki speed hai. Musbat Δλ (redshift) = cheez door ja rahi hai; manfi Δλ (blueshift) = qareeb aa rahi hai.
Phailne ka saboot:
1. Door ki galaxies ki absorption aur emission lines apni lab wali wavelengths se lambi wavelength par milti hain (Fig. 21.5).
2. Redshift har simt mein nazar aata hai, yani tamam door ki galaxies hum se door ja rahi hain.
3. Roshni is liye khinchti hai ke us ke safar ke dauran space khud khinch rahi hai: galaxies ke darmiyan space barh rahi hai (balloon model: har nuqta baqi sab ko door jata dekhta hai, koi khaas markaz nahi).
Misal: 656 nm wali line 700 nm par: Z = 44/656 = 0.067, v = Zc = 0.067 × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ = 2.0 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ (door ja rahi hai).
Hubble's law: Hubble ne dekha ke galaxy jitni door, us ka redshift utna zyada, yani utni tez door ja rahi hai: v ∝ d, v = H₀d, H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹. Recession velocity aur fasle ka graph seedhi line hai jis ka slope H₀ hai (Fig. 21.6). Upar wali misal mein d = v/H₀ = (2.0 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹)/(2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹) ≈ 8.7 × 10²⁴ m.
Big Bang Theory: agar universe abhi phail raha hai to waqt ulta chalane se pata chalta hai ke maazi mein galaxies qareeb thin, aur mazeed peechhe tamam maadda bohat chhoti, ghani aur garam haalat mein tha. Universe isi haalat se taqreeban 13.8 arab saal pehle shuru hua aur tab se phail raha hai. (Taqreeban 1/H₀ = 1/(2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹) ≈ 4.3 × 10¹⁷ s ≈ 14 arab saal, jo is umar ke qareeb hai; chapter se aage.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ghubaare (balloon) par nuqte lagao aur phulao. Har nuqta baqi nuqton ko apne se door jata dekhta hai, aur jo nuqta zyada door hai woh zyada tezi se door hota hai. Yehi Hubble's law hai. Ghubaare ko ulta pichkao to sab nuqte ek jagah aa jayenge: yehi Big Bang ka khayal hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.6 Describe how Earth's climate system functions as a complex system involving the atmosphere, oceans, ice, land, and living things. How do ocean salinity and thermohaline circulation help transport heat from the equator toward the poles?
Bayan karein ke Zameen ka climate system atmosphere, samandar, barf, zameen aur jandaron par mushtamil ek pecheeda (complex) nizaam ke taur par kaise kaam karta hai. Samandar ki salinity (namkeeni) aur thermohaline circulation garmi ko equator se poles tak kaise le jati hain?
blocks.explanation:
Climate system ek pecheeda nizaam: Zameen ka climate temperature, barish, hawa aur doosre mausami halaat ka lamba (long-term) pattern hai. Yeh paanch aapas mein mutasir hone wale hisson se bana hai:
1. Atmosphere (hawa): hawaon ke zariye garmi aur nami le jati hai; greenhouse gases infrared radiation rokti hain.
2. Hydrosphere (samandar aur paani): bohat si garmi jama karta hai aur currents se le jata hai; evaporation se badal aur barish banti hai.
3. Cryosphere (barf aur permafrost): chamakdar barf dhoop reflect kar ke Zameen ko thanda rakhti hai; samandari barf banne se salinity badalti hai.
4. Lithosphere (zameen): garmi jazb aur kharij karti hai; volcano gases aur gard chhorte hain.
5. Biosphere (jandar): paude carbon dioxide jazb aur paani ke bukharat (transpiration) kharij karte hain; insaan greenhouse gases barhate hain.
Yeh hisse energy, paani aur gases ka len den karte hain aur ek doosre par asar dalte hain: ek mein tabdeeli doosron ko badal deti hai (misal: garmi se barf pighalti hai, gehri satah khulti hai jo zyada dhoop jazb kar ke mazeed garmi laati hai). Sab kuch solar energy aur Zameen ki gardish se chalta hai, is liye yeh pecheeda nizaam hai.
Salinity ka kirdar: ghula hua namak paani ka mass barhata hai magar volume zyada nahi badalta, is liye namkeen paani zyada dense (ghana) hai. Thanda paani bhi garam paani se zyada dense hai. Temperature aur salinity se density ka farq gehre samandar ka circulation chalata hai.
Thermohaline circulation (global conveyor belt):
1. Garam, kam dense satah ka paani equator se poles ki taraf garmi le kar jata hai (Fig. 21.15 mein laal ribbons).
2. Poles ke qareeb woh apni garmi hawa ko de kar thanda hota hai; samandari barf bante waqt namak paani mein reh jata hai, is liye paani thanda, namkeen aur dense ho jata hai.
3. Yeh bhaari paani neeche doob kar samandar ki teh ke saath equator ki taraf wapas behta hai (neele ribbons).
4. Doosre ilaqon mein woh phir upar uthta hai aur satah par aa jata hai; poora chakkar taqreeban 1,000 saal mein mukammal hota hai.
Is tarah garmi tropics se poles tak jati hai, oonche latitudes garam rehte hain, climate qaboo mein rehta hai aur nutrients aur gases (oxygen, carbon dioxide) baante jate hain. Satah ke currents aur gyres (hawa aur Zameen ki gardish se) ke saath mil kar yeh equator aur poles ke energy farq ko barabar karta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Thermohaline circulation ko ek bari conveyor belt (chalti patti) samjho: oopar wali patti garam paani equator se poles tak le jati hai, wahan paani thanda aur namkeen ho kar bhaari ho jata hai aur neeche doob jata hai, phir neeche wali patti use wapas equator ki taraf le aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
21.1 A star radiates with a total power of 3.6 × 10²⁶ W. What is the radiant flux received by Earth located 1.5 × 10¹¹ m away from the star? (Ans: 1.3 × 10³ W m⁻²)
Ek sitara 3.6 × 10²⁶ W kul power kharij karta hai. Sitare se 1.5 × 10¹¹ m door Zameen ko kitna radiant flux milta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: L = 3.6 × 10²⁶ W, d = 1.5 × 10¹¹ m
Maloom karna: radiant flux intensity F = ?
Formula: F = L/4πd²
F = (3.6 × 10²⁶ W)/[4 × 3.14 × (1.5 × 10¹¹ m)²]
F = (3.6 × 10²⁶ W)/(4 × 3.14 × 2.25 × 10²² m²)
F = (3.6 × 10²⁶ W)/(2.83 × 10²³ m²)
F = 1.27 × 10³ W m⁻² ≈ 1.3 × 10³ W m⁻²
Jawab: F ≈ 1.3 × 10³ W m⁻² (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
21.2 A supernova, acting as a standard candle, has a luminosity of 1.0 × 10³⁶ W. If the observed flux at Earth is 2.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻², calculate the distance between the Earth and the supernova. (Ans: 2 × 10²³ m)
Standard candle ka kaam dene wale ek supernova ki luminosity 1.0 × 10³⁶ W hai. Agar Zameen par napa gaya flux 2.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻² ho to Zameen aur supernova ka fasla maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: L = 1.0 × 10³⁶ W, F = 2.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻²
Maloom karna: fasla d = ?
Formula: F = L/4πd², is liye d = √(L/4πF)
d = √[(1.0 × 10³⁶ W)/(4 × 3.14 × 2.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻²)]
d = √[(1.0 × 10³⁶ W)/(2.51 × 10⁻¹¹ W m⁻²)]
d = √(3.98 × 10⁴⁶ m²)
d = 2.0 × 10²³ m
Jawab: d ≈ 2 × 10²³ m (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
21.3 The peak wavelength of radiation from a star is observed to be 500 nm. Estimate the surface temperature of the star. (Ans: 5800 K)
Ek sitare ki radiation ki peak wavelength 500 nm napi gayi. Sitare ka surface temperature andaza karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: λmax = 500 nm = 500 × 10⁻⁹ m = 5.0 × 10⁻⁷ m, b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K
Maloom karna: surface temperature T = ?
Formula (Wien's displacement law): λmax T = b, is liye T = b/λmax
T = (2.9 × 10⁻³ m K)/(5.0 × 10⁻⁷ m)
T = 5.8 × 10³ K
Jawab: T = 5800 K (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
21.4 Calculate the luminosity of a star having a radius of 7.0 × 10⁸ m and a surface temperature of 6000 K. (Ans: 4.5 × 10²⁶ W)
Radius 7.0 × 10⁸ m aur surface temperature 6000 K wale sitare ki luminosity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: r = 7.0 × 10⁸ m, T = 6000 K, σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴
Maloom karna: luminosity L = ?
Formula (Stefan-Boltzmann law): L = 4πr²σT⁴
r² = (7.0 × 10⁸ m)² = 4.9 × 10¹⁷ m²
T⁴ = (6000 K)⁴ = 1.296 × 10¹⁵ K⁴
L = 4 × 3.14 × 4.9 × 10¹⁷ m² × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ × 1.296 × 10¹⁵ K⁴
L = 6.15 × 10¹⁸ m² × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ × 1.296 × 10¹⁵ K⁴
L = 4.52 × 10²⁶ W
Jawab: L ≈ 4.5 × 10²⁶ W (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
21.5 A star emits a total power of 3.9 × 10²⁶ W and has a surface temperature of 5800 K. Estimate the radius of the star. (Ans: 7.0 × 10⁸ m)
Ek sitara 3.9 × 10²⁶ W kul power kharij karta hai aur us ka surface temperature 5800 K hai. Sitare ka radius andaza karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: L = 3.9 × 10²⁶ W, T = 5800 K, σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴
Maloom karna: radius r = ?
Formula: L = 4πr²σT⁴, is liye r = √(L/4πσT⁴)
T⁴ = (5800 K)⁴ = 1.13 × 10¹⁵ K⁴
4πσT⁴ = 4 × 3.14 × 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ × 1.13 × 10¹⁵ K⁴ = 8.06 × 10⁸ W m⁻²
r = √[(3.9 × 10²⁶ W)/(8.06 × 10⁸ W m⁻²)]
r = √(4.84 × 10¹⁷ m²)
r = 6.96 × 10⁸ m ≈ 7.0 × 10⁸ m
Jawab: r ≈ 7.0 × 10⁸ m (kitab se milta hai; taqreeban Suraj ka radius).

blocks.prompt:
21.6 A spectral line that normally appears at 656 nm is observed from a distant galaxy at 700 nm. Calculate the redshift of the galaxy. (Ans: 0.067 m)
Jo spectral line aam taur par 656 nm par hoti hai, woh door ki galaxy se 700 nm par nazar aati hai. Galaxy ka redshift maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: λ (lab wali) = 656 nm, λnazar aane wali = 700 nm
Maloom karna: redshift Z = ?
Formula: Z = Δλ/λ
Δλ = λnazar aane wali − λ = 700 nm − 656 nm = 44 nm
Z = (44 nm)/(656 nm)
Z = 0.067 (koi unit nahi)
Jawab: Z = 0.067. Δλ musbat hai, is liye galaxy hum se door ja rahi hai (v = Zc ≈ 2.0 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne jawab "0.067 m" likha hai. Redshift Z = Δλ/λ do wavelengths ki nisbat (ratio) hai (nm/nm), is liye is ka koi unit nahi: Z = 0.067.

blocks.prompt:
21.7 Light from a galaxy is redshifted, showing a shift value of 0.1. Determine the speed at which the galaxy is receding from the Earth. (Ans: 30,000 km s⁻¹)
Ek galaxy ki roshni mein 0.1 ka redshift hai. Galaxy kis speed se Zameen se door ja rahi hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Z = 0.1, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: door jane ki speed v = ?
Formula: Z ≈ v/c, is liye v = Zc
v = 0.1 × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
v = 3 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ = 3 × 10⁴ km s⁻¹
Jawab: v = 30,000 km s⁻¹ (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
21.8 A galaxy is receding from the Earth at a speed of 2.1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹. Using a Hubble constant of 70 km s⁻¹/ Mpc, find the distance to the galaxy. (Ans: 9.26 × 10²³ m)
Ek galaxy 2.1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ ki speed se Zameen se door ja rahi hai. Hubble constant 70 km s⁻¹/Mpc le kar galaxy ka fasla maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: v = 2.1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ = 2.1 × 10³ km s⁻¹, H₀ = 70 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹
1 Mpc (megaparsec) = 3.086 × 10²² m (chapter se aage)
Maloom karna: fasla d = ?
Formula (Hubble's law): v = H₀d, is liye d = v/H₀
d = (2.1 × 10³ km s⁻¹)/(70 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹)
d = 30 Mpc
d = 30 × 3.086 × 10²² m
d = 9.26 × 10²³ m
Jawab: d = 9.26 × 10²³ m (kitab se milta hai).
Chapter wale H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ (jo SI units mein 70 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹ hi hai) se check: d = (2.1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹)/(2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹) = 9.1 × 10²³ m, rounding ke farq ke saath wahi jawab.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Megaparsec (Mpc) astronomy mein faslay ki bari ikai (unit) hai: 1 Mpc = 3.086 × 10²² m. Hubble constant 70 km s⁻¹/Mpc ka matlab hai ke har 1 Mpc door galaxy 70 km s⁻¹ ki raftaar se door ja rahi hai. Is sawal mein galaxy 2100 km s⁻¹ se door ja rahi hai, to 2100 ÷ 70 = 30 Mpc door hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab: 1 c, 2 c, 3 d, 4 a, 5 b, 6 d, 7 c, 8 c, 9 a, 10 b.
MCQ 21.5: kisi option mein chapter wala milap (Wien's law + Stefan-Boltzmann law) nahi; sab se qareeb jawab (b) hai.
Numerical 21.6: redshift ka koi unit nahi; sahi jawab Z = 0.067 hai (kitab "0.067 m" likhti hai).
Baqi sab numericals ke jawab kitab se milte hain; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
